lines: One strike from Sakura sent a drone loudly flying and made it crash into a wall.
The drones were being taken out one after another at the hands of the experienced mercenaries, and the tide had turned.
In the midst of that, Sakura had been putting on a display of extraordinary effort.
That's her fourth, fifth... eighth!! That girl's got a cute face and can hold her own!!
I knew she was strong from the test earlier, but to think she was this strong...
Oohing and aahing next to me was the Orc Mercenary who had tested Sakura's ability.
His eyes were no longer those of someone looking at a little girl, but of someone looking, with a hint of irritation, at a comrade-in-arms or a skilled adversary.
Hey, that girl's your partner, yeah? Compared to her you're nothing!! Put some more work into it!
(Shut up! I've got my own circumstances over here!!)
I retorted in my mind as I glared back at the Orc.
Waiting for an opening to go investigate the "cargo," I hadn't actively participated in the battle.
But ironically, due to Sakura's efforts, the battle had ended smoothly before I had had a chance.
I'm back~! Fuma-kun, you were still alive?
Somehow. Looks like you also did your best.
Oh! Did you watch me~? It's for our fancy dinner so I gave it my all!
The Orc Mercenary next to me laughed and called out to Sakura, who was puffing her chest out with pride.
Hey girl, you're pretty great! I've also been a mercenary for years, but I've never seen a little girl as strong as you.
Whoa, really~? You've got a keen eye~!!
How about you also teach this useless git here how to fight?! In bed, if you prefer! Ghahahaha!
Sakura seemed to be totally hitting it off with the surprisingly good-natured Orc Mercenary.
(Sheesh... no tension in the air with these guys...)
The battle was over and the mercenaries were slowly coming out of the building.
In response to that command, we hurried to our stations as well.
